description: A brown long-sleeved knee-length wool tunic with restrained pale red-and-cream woven geometric trim at the split collar, cuffs and hem, over a cream linen underlayer at the neck and wrists. A plain brown leather belt with a modest metal buckle and long hanging end, brown trousers, grey-beige wrapped lower legs and brown leather ankle shoes complete the outfit. No headgear, armor or weapons.
